intro: Choosing between family anime portrait styles is about more than picking a favourite show. The best style should suit the number of people, the personalities in the photo, the role of any pets and the mood you want to preserve. A playful family may work beautifully in a bright cartoon style, while a multi-generational portrait may need a softer composition with clear facial details. Anime Cabinet offers 24 anime and cartoon-inspired styles, each drawn by a human artist from your reference photos. Your family becomes a group of original characters in the visual language of your chosen style, rather than a direct copy or copyrighted-character impersonation. You receive a preview within 72 hours and unlimited free revisions, so the final artwork can feel personal before you order a print or [custom anime portrait canvas](/portraits/ghibli-style).
